To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the B3LYP method, with the 6‐31G* basis set, is a good alternative to the AM1 method for QSAR modeling.
the density functional theory (DFT) method is a better tool for the study of the inhibition of phenylethylamine derivatives.
B3LYP is better than AM1 in the QSAR study of phenylispropylamines as MAO‐A inhibitors.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of QSAR models based on semiempiric (AM1) or density functional theory (DFT) methods, which can be used for prediction and design of new MAO‐A inhibitors.
the application of a new approach to the study of inhibition of MAO‐a by phenylisoppropylamine derivatives.
the use of computational chemistry in the design of novel phenylisopropyamines.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
B3LYP method is more reliable and more accurate than the AM1 method for predicting the inhibitory activity of MAO‐a by phenylisopropyamines.
the density functional theory method is superior to the semiempirical method for QSAR studies of phenylisopropanolamines as MAO inhibitors.
the density functional theory (DFT)‐based models provide a more accurate prediction of the inhibitory activity of MAO‐B than semiempirical (PM3)‐based models.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the density functional theory method (B3LYPP) can provide more accurate results than the semiempirical method.
the B3LYP method is a better choice for the prediction of the activity of the MAO‐A inhibitors.
the density functional theory (DFT) method (B3LYPP) is a better method than the semiempirical method for the inhibition of phenyisopropylamine.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the flip regression method is a useful tool for the prediction of biological activities of compounds.
the density functional theory method is a good tool for the study of biological activities.
